name: Vidiksha IP
description: Vidiksha IP is a boutique trademark law firm in India. Clearance, filing, prosecution, oppositions, enforcement, anti-counterfeiting, licensing and Madrid filings for Indian and international brand owners.
footerLine: A specialist trademark practice for brand owners in India and abroad.

hero.title: Counsel for the marks your business is known by.
hero.lede: Vidiksha IP is a specialist trademark practice. Clearance, prosecution, oppositions, enforcement and licensing before the Trade Marks Registry, the High Courts and the Madrid system. Nothing else, by design.

statement.title: A trademark is the one asset a business cannot replace. We built a firm around protecting it.
statement.text: Most intellectual property practices treat trademarks as one department among many. We treat them as the whole discipline. Every matter at Vidiksha IP, from a first availability search to a contested injunction, is handled by lawyers who do trademark work and only trademark work, and who have seen how a decision taken at filing plays out years later in an opposition or a courtroom.

approach.title: Specialist by choice. Measured by outcomes.

items.title: One discipline
items.text: We do not accept patent, corporate or general litigation work. Depth in one area is the service.

items.title: Senior attention
items.text: Every matter is led by a senior lawyer who reads the file, signs the filing and appears at the hearing.

items.title: Written for the record
items.text: Advice is given in writing, with the reasoning shown, so that it stands up when the matter is contested.

items.title: Clear scope and fees
items.text: A defined scope and a fee estimate before work begins. No surprises on the invoice, at any stage.

sectors.title: Brand owners at every stage, in India and from abroad.
sectors.text: From a founder filing a first mark to an international house managing hundreds of registrations through Indian counsel, the work is the same: get the right protection, keep it, and use it when it matters.

contactBand.title: Begin with a conversation.
contactBand.text: Tell us about the mark, the matter or the market. We reply within one working day with a view on the way forward and what it would cost.

about.title: Trademarks, and only trademarks.
about.lede: Vidiksha IP was founded on a simple observation: the businesses that lose their marks rarely lose them in court. They lose them earlier, in a search that was never run, a response that was never argued, or a licence that was never policed.
story: The firm exists to do that earlier work properly, and to be the same counsel in the room when a matter does become contested. We advise on clearance and filing strategy, prosecute applications through examination and hearing, run oppositions and rectifications, enforce registered and unregistered rights before the Commercial Courts and the Intellectual Property Divisions of the High Courts, and structure the licences, assignments and coexistence arrangements that let a brand grow without losing its footing.

We act for Indian companies building brands at home and abroad, and for international brand owners who need Indian counsel that understands both the practice of the Registry and the expectations of a foreign in-house team. Instructions come to us directly from businesses and through law firms and IP agencies overseas.

We are a boutique by design. The firm is small enough that the lawyer who gives the first opinion is the lawyer who argues the hearing, and specialised enough that we have usually seen the point before. That combination is what we offer, and it is why we do not do anything else.

items.title: Candour before comfort
items.text: If a mark is weak, a case is thin or a filing is a waste of money, we say so at the outset, in writing.

items.title: Precision in the record
items.text: Registry and court files outlive the people who made them. Every submission is drafted to be read by a stranger years from now.

items.title: Proportion
items.text: The right response to a problem is not always the most aggressive one. We match the remedy to the commercial stakes.

items.title: Care in the small print
items.text: Specifications, user claims, licence clauses and recordals decide more disputes than courtroom advocacy. We treat them accordingly.

items.title: Conflict check
items.text: Every enquiry is cleared against our existing matters before we read anything confidential.

items.title: Scope and estimate
items.text: You receive a written scope, a professional fee estimate and the official fees involved before any work begins.

items.title: A single point of contact
items.text: One lawyer owns the matter and reports on it. You will not have to explain the history twice.

items.title: Reporting on a schedule
items.text: Deadlines, Registry actions and court dates are docketed and reported to you in advance, not after the fact.

founder.name: Deepansh Bhati
bio: Deepansh Bhati founded Vidiksha IP and leads every matter the firm takes on. His practice covers the full life of a trademark: clearance and filing strategy, prosecution before the Trade Marks Registry, oppositions and rectification, enforcement before the Commercial Courts and the Intellectual Property Divisions of the High Courts, and the licensing and brand transactions that follow.

He acts for Indian businesses building brands at home and abroad, and for international brand owners and their counsel who need Indian trademark work handled with the same care and reporting discipline they expect at home.
